name: plan-cmd-e2e-db-at-single-agent-and-span
body: db_at carries only agent.implementer, so a scenario needing another Agent (e.g. the drift case's agent.ghost) must add it itself; and the fixture's Agent end_line is a fixed 546 snapshot of .opencode/agents/implementer.md (no test reads the span — the roster query reads fqn only). Limits: one shared Agent, and a fixed span snapshot. Upgrade: add more agents to the shared payload if needed, and refresh the span if the definition changes.
